Commentary of Ibn Sa'di (Taysir al-Karim al-Rahman) on surah 99, verses 1–8:

It is Medinan.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

{1–2} He, exalted is He, informs of what will happen on the Day of Resurrection: that the earth will be shaken, trembling and quaking violently, until whatever is upon it of buildings and landmarks collapses, its mountains are crushed to dust, its hills are leveled, and it becomes a smooth, level plain, with no crookedness or elevation in it. ﴿And the earth will bring forth its burdens﴾; that is, what is in its belly of the dead and the treasures.

{3} ﴿And man will say﴾: when he sees the great matter that has befallen it [considering it greatly momentous]: ﴿What is wrong with it?﴾; that is, what has happened to it?

{4–5} ﴿That Day, it will report its news﴾: the earth will bear witness to the workers about what they did upon its surface, of good and evil; for the earth is among the witnesses who will testify against the servants concerning their deeds. ﴿That is because your Lord has inspired it﴾; that is, He commanded it to report what was done upon it, so it does not disobey His command.

{6} ﴿That Day, the people will depart in scattered groups﴾: from the place of standing on the Day of Resurrection [when Allah judges between them], ﴿in separate groups﴾; that is, divided into varying ranks, ﴿to be shown their deeds﴾; that is, so that Allah shows them what they did of evil and good, and shows them their recompense in full.

{7–8} ﴿So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.﴾ This is a comprehensive and general statement covering all good and all evil; for if one sees the weight of an atom, the smallest of things, and is recompensed for it, then what is above it is more fitting and more deserving of that. As Allah, exalted is He, said: ﴿The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present, and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between it and that were a great distance﴾ [3:30], and ﴿they will find what they had done present﴾ [18:49]. This contains encouragement to do good, even if little, and warning against doing evil, even if trivial.
